notices.title: Employment Services Amendment Bill [B16–2026]
notices.description: Regulates the employment of foreign nationals and updates enforcement and protections under the Employment Services Act. Parliament invites citizens, civil society, business and organised labour to comment.
instructions: Read the bill and the official parliamentary call.
Email written submissions for the attention of Mr Zolani Sakasa.
Say whether you would like to make a verbal presentation at a future hearing. No hearing date is stated in this call.
notices.committee: Portfolio Committee on Employment and Labour

notices.title: Draft National Building Regulations and Building Standards Amendment Bill
notices.description: The Department of Trade, Industry and Competition seeks comments on proposed amendments to the national building regulations and building standards framework. Read the full draft and government notice for the proposed provisions.
instructions: Read the issuing notice and the linked full document before commenting.
Check the issuing authority for changes and confirm any unpublished cutoff time.
notices.dateNote: No cutoff time is stated on the PMG call; confirm the time with the issuing authority.

notices.title: Draft Stock Theft Amendment Bill
notices.description: The Civilian Secretariat for the Police Service invites written comments on its draft 2026 Stock Theft Amendment Bill. The linked government notice and full draft set out the proposed changes.
instructions: Read the issuing notice and the linked full document before commenting.
Check the issuing authority for changes and confirm any unpublished cutoff time.
notices.dateNote: No cutoff time is stated on the PMG call; confirm the time with the issuing authority.

notices.title: Draft Second-Hand Goods Amendment Bill
notices.description: Proposes changes to second-hand dealer registration, records, inspections, enforcement and penalties, including vehicle microdots and communication equipment. The draft also addresses foreign dealers, minors pawning goods and nonprofit exemptions.
instructions: Read the draft bill and the linked socioeconomic impact assessment.
Email your written comments to SHGA_Bill@csp.gov.za.
Enquiries: Colonel Gerhard Pretorius, (012) 393 9007, PretoriusG@saps.gov.za.
notices.dateNote: No cutoff time is stated on the PMG call; confirm the time with the issuing authority.

notices.title: Universal Access and Universal Service discussion document
notices.description: The Universal Service and Access Agency of South Africa invites comments on its discussion document on universal access and universal service. This is a policy consultation rather than a bill.
instructions: Read the issuing notice and the linked full document before commenting.
Check the issuing authority for changes and confirm any unpublished cutoff time.
notices.dateNote: No cutoff time is stated on the PMG call; confirm the time with the issuing authority.

notices.title: Draft Strategic Framework for Water and Sanitation
notices.description: The Department of Water and Sanitation asks the public to comment on the draft strategic framework for water and sanitation services. The source links the draft framework and government notice.
instructions: Read the issuing notice and the linked full document before commenting.
Check the issuing authority for changes and confirm any unpublished cutoff time.
notices.dateNote: No cutoff time is stated on the PMG call; confirm the time with the issuing authority.

notices.title: Revised Electricity Pricing Policy 2026
notices.description: The Department of Electricity and Energy invites written comments on its revised electricity pricing policy. The source includes a published extension notice and the full policy.
instructions: Read the issuing notice and the linked full document before commenting.
Check the issuing authority for changes and confirm any unpublished cutoff time.
notices.dateNote: No cutoff time is stated on the PMG call; confirm the time with the issuing authority.

notices.title: Electricity Sector Market Transformation Position Paper
notices.description: The Department of Electricity and Energy seeks comments on its 2026 position paper on electricity market transformation. The deadline reflects the linked extension notice.
instructions: Read the issuing notice and the linked full document before commenting.
Check the issuing authority for changes and confirm any unpublished cutoff time.
notices.dateNote: No cutoff time is stated on the PMG call; confirm the time with the issuing authority.

notices.title: General Finance Laws Amendment Bill [B21–2026]
notices.description: Proposes replacement financial benchmark provisions and changes to the Public Procurement Act implementation-review timeframe. The Standing Committee on Finance invited written input and requests for oral presentations.
instructions: Send written submissions to Mr Allen Wicomb and Ms Lwazikazi Ntinzi.
Specifically request an oral presentation if you want to speak at the hearing.
Ask the committee for the hearing time and Zoom joining details; neither is published in this call.
notices.location: Zoom virtual hearing; joining details must be obtained from the committee

notices.title: 2026 Revised Fiscal Framework and Revenue Proposals
notices.description: Parliament’s finance committees invite input on the revised fiscal framework and revenue proposals accompanying the Medium Term Budget Policy Statement, due to be tabled on 21 October 2026.
instructions: Read the 2026 MTBPS when Treasury publishes it on 21 October.
Send written submissions to the three committee secretaries by the stated noon deadline.
Indicate whether you want to make an oral presentation and request the virtual hearing joining details.
notices.location: Virtual public hearing; joining details must be obtained from the committees
notices.committee: Standing Committee on Finance and Select Committee on Finance

notices.title: Public comments on Central Drug Authority shortlisted candidates
notices.description: Parliament invites comments on 27 shortlisted candidates for 13 Central Drug Authority board vacancies. Candidate CVs are linked in the official statement, supporting scrutiny of a public appointment process.
instructions: Read the shortlisted candidates’ CVs linked in Parliament’s statement.
Send written comments to the committee secretary, Ms L Ntsabo.
Distinguish evidence about suitability from unsupported allegations.
notices.committee: Portfolio Committee on Social Development and Select Committee on Social Services
notices.dateNote: The source gives the closing date but no cutoff time.

notices.title: Second Special Appropriation (2025/26 FY) Bill [B20–2026] · NCOP call
notices.description: The Select Committee on Appropriations invited written or oral input on the bill tabled on 30 July 2026. This documented consultation and its 8 October hearing have passed.
instructions: This is an archived consultation.
Read the bill, the committee’s detailed notice and subsequent reports.
Ask the committee to resolve the conflicting index date before treating any later submission window as open.
notices.dateNote: Source conflict: Parliament’s calls index lists 16 October, but its linked detailed notice and PMG both state 6 October. This record uses the detailed notice and does not assume an extension. Confirm with the committee.

notices.title: Gauteng Provincial Appropriation Bill 2026 [G002–2026]
notices.description: Appropriates money from the Gauteng Provincial Revenue Fund for the financial year ending 31 March 2027. The Finance Portfolio Committee’s March written-submission window is archived.
instructions: Archived: this March submission window is closed.
Read the full bill and consult the legislature for the subsequent legislative stage.
The original advert requested full name, subject matter, email address and/or contact number.

notices.title: Second Gauteng Adjustments Appropriation Bill [G001–2026]
notices.description: Adjusts appropriations from the Gauteng Provincial Revenue Fund for the 2025/26 financial year ending 31 March 2026. The call for written submissions closed in March.
instructions: Archived: the original submission deadline has passed.
Read the published bill and later legislature records to establish its subsequent status.

notices.title: Gauteng Legislature Service Repeal Bill 2025 · hearing
notices.description: A proposed repeal of the Gauteng Provincial Legislature Service Act 5 of 1996. The Speaker invited the public to a February 2026 hearing; this is a historical notice.
instructions: This hearing has already taken place.
Consult the legislature’s bill and committee records for subsequent proceedings.
notices.location: GPL Auditorium, 1st Floor, Gauteng Provincial Legislature
notices.dateNote: The event has passed. The notice does not establish the bill’s current legislative stage.

notices.title: Western Cape Twentieth Gambling and Racing Amendment Bill [B2–2026]
notices.description: The introduced bill proposes an increased bid fee, called an economic opportunity tax, when a casino relocation application is granted. The full bill is published in English, Afrikaans and isiXhosa.
instructions: Read the introduced bill and explanatory text.
Check WCPP’s bill tracker for the current stage.
Contact the relevant committee for any current opportunity to comment.
notices.dateNote: Published bill text only. No current public-comment deadline or hearing invitation is established by this source; check the bill tracker and committee.

notices.title: Parliamentary oversight: Eskom tariffs and municipal debt
notices.description: The Standing Committee on Appropriations is scheduled to receive an Eskom briefing on tariff adjustments, tariff reform, municipal debt and a proposal concerning indigent budget allocations.
instructions: Check Parliament’s latest committee schedule for changes.
This is an oversight meeting, not an advertised public-submission hearing.
Ask the committee about public observation or watch Parliament’s published broadcast.

notices.title: Parliamentary oversight: BELA Act implementation
notices.description: The NCOP education committee is scheduled to hear a Department of Basic Education briefing on BELA Act implementation and regulations undergoing public consultation.
instructions: Confirm the current schedule with Parliament.
This listing is a committee briefing; it does not establish a separate open comment window for any regulations.
Use the issuing department’s actual consultation notice before submitting regulatory comments.
notices.committee: Select Committee on Education, Sciences and Creative Industries

notices.title: P20 Youth Parliament: higher education follow-through
notices.description: Assesses progress on youth-parliament recommendations concerning disability funding, skills and workplace placements, GBVF reporting, sport careers and student debt.
instructions: Read the full committee report and its recommendations.
Consult subsequent parliamentary records before assuming a recommendation was implemented.

notices.title: Zilandana community petition: ward-demarcation consultation
notices.description: Records how Parliament considered a community petition about consultation and ward demarcation in Kumkani Mhlontlo. The committee resolved to close the petition and request progress updates every six months.
instructions: Read the full committee report and its recommendations.
Consult subsequent parliamentary records before assuming a recommendation was implemented.

notices.title: Municipal accountability: Masilonyana and Msunduzi
notices.description: SCOPA’s report records hearings with these municipalities, financial governance concerns and oversight recommendations. It enables residents to examine the committee’s findings and required follow-up.
instructions: Read the full committee report and its recommendations.
Consult subsequent parliamentary records before assuming a recommendation was implemented.

notices.title: Access to information: PAIA rules report
notices.description: The Justice committee recommends approval of rules of procedure under section 79(1) of the Promotion of Access to Information Act. This short report is a recommendation, not a new public call.
instructions: Read the full committee report and its recommendations.
Consult subsequent parliamentary records before assuming a recommendation was implemented.
notices.committee: Portfolio Committee on Justice and Constitutional Development

notices.title: Mangaung development petition: NCOP hearing
notices.description: The NCOP petitions committee’s scheduled oversight visit includes a hearing about administrative and regulatory barriers affecting the proposed development of Portion 3 of Farm Klipfontein 716 in Mangaung Metropolitan Municipality.
notices.location: Free State Province; the weekly notice does not publish a specific street venue
notices.committee: Select Committee on Public Petitions and Executive Undertakings
instructions: Confirm the detailed venue and current programme with the committee before travelling.
The weekly statement lists a petition hearing but does not advertise a general submission deadline or unrestricted public-speaking opportunity.
Follow the petition’s later committee report and recommendations to understand its outcome.
notices.dateNote: Official weekly parliamentary schedule, not a municipal bylaw consultation. Attendance arrangements and exact venue require confirmation.

notices.title: Cape Town: draft combined rules for Ward Committees
notices.description: A review of the rules governing ward committees: their roles, reporting, accountability, transparency and support for meaningful community participation. This is a municipal rules consultation, not a parliamentary bill.
notices.location: Written comments online or at your nearest Cape Town subcouncil office; no hearing venue is announced.
notices.contact: General enquiries: AlesiaValda.Bosman@capetown.gov.za or JustinJoseph.Hendricks@capetown.gov.za. Participation assistance: public.participation@capetown.gov.za; 0800 212 176.
instructions: Read the draft combined rules and the English, Afrikaans or isiXhosa summary linked in the City notice.
Submit through the City’s published online comment form, or deliver written comments to a subcouncil office during the stated comment period.
Identify the rule you are commenting on, the practical effect, and your proposed improvement. The City offers help for people with disabilities or who cannot read or write.
notices.dateNote: The source publishes a closing date but no exact cutoff time. Confirm the time with the City. This is a written-comment window; a physical hearing date is not inferred.

notices.title: Cape Town: proposed process plan for the 2027–2032 IDP
notices.description: Comment on how the next five-year Integrated Development Plan will be prepared, consulted on, adopted and reviewed. This consultation concerns the process plan; later consultation on the draft IDP is a separate step.
notices.location: Online or email comments; written delivery to your nearest City subcouncil office or library.
instructions: Read the process plan and the proposed stages for public engagement.
Submit comments using the official online form, by email to NTO5YR@capetown.gov.za, or by hand at a subcouncil office or library.
Explain how the timetable and consultation methods could make participation more accessible. Check later City notices for the separate draft-IDP consultation.
notices.dateNote: The source publishes a closing date but no exact cutoff time. Confirm the time with the City. This is a written-comment window; a physical hearing date is not inferred.

notices.title: Cape Town: Kensington, Factreton and Wingfield spatial-development framework
notices.description: A local spatial-development framework setting a vision and guidelines for housing, access, safety, public land, services, biodiversity and economic opportunities in the Kensington/Factreton/Wingfield area.
notices.location: Kensington, Factreton and Wingfield are the planning area. This record is a written-comment opportunity; no future hearing venue is established.
instructions: Read the draft LSDF, baseline report and supporting documents linked by the City.
Submit through the official online form or email TableBay.DistrictSDF@capetown.gov.za; use the City notice for any hand-delivery arrangements.
Identify the place or proposal affected and explain your evidence, concern and recommended change.
notices.dateNote: The source publishes a closing date but no exact cutoff time. Confirm the time with the City. This is a written-comment window; a physical hearing date is not inferred.

notices.title: Cape Town: proposed MyCiTi stops in Atlantis and Big Bay
notices.description: Comments on eight proposed MyCiTi stops intended to shorten walking distances and improve passenger access in Atlantis and Big Bay. The notice lists each stop and reference number so residents can address specific locations.
notices.location: Hand delivery: Subcouncil 1, 14 Hermes Ave, Saxonsea, 7349. This is a submission address, not an announced public hearing.
instructions: Read the stop locations and reference numbers in the City notice and MyCiTi source links.
Use the published online form, email MyCiTi.News@capetown.gov.za, or deliver comments to Subcouncil 1 at the stated address.
Name the relevant stop/reference number and explain access, safety, walking-distance or route concerns.
notices.dateNote: The source publishes a closing date but no exact cutoff time. Confirm the time with the City. This is a written-comment window; a physical hearing date is not inferred.

notices.title: Mangaung: August 2026 municipal financial and budget statement
notices.description: The municipality’s MFMA section 71 monthly financial report and budget statement for the period ending 31 August 2026. Use it to examine budget implementation and the municipality’s financial position; its publication is not an open submission invitation.
notices.location: Mangaung Metropolitan Municipality, Free State; report available online.
instructions: Open the official municipal page and download the linked monthly financial report.
Compare implementation and material variances with the approved budget and related IDP/SDBIP documents.
Use the municipality’s published council, public-participation or enquiry channels for questions. No comment deadline is inferred from the report date.
